title: Fix Puzzle 5d 2d Preview Missing When Suggesting Parts From 2d
description: When adding a new suggested part in 2D in puzzle 5d, the preview shows in 3D but the new 2D node and edge are missing in 2D. Root cause: puzzle5dSyncBrushPreviewFromVolume calls flatRenderer.brushCancelSlot() when volume preview is null but flat session has sourceHandleId, racing with 2D-originated suggestions before volume sync completes.
summary: Fixed puzzle 5d 2D brush suggestion preview gaps. (1) Volume→flat paired sync no longer cancels flat slots while flat is driving suggestions (origin tracking). (2) Intermittent missing preview edge: WASM drains during candidate changes no longer clobber the shared suggestions session on the driving pane; previews must include both node and edge before accepting drained WASM state, and suggestions-active session updates preserve the last complete preview when WASM briefly emits empty partial data.
